evidence.visual: Theme-specific ink fading and hand-built SVG diagrams directly explain memory decay, retrieval, and rescheduling; no gradients, card wall, fake metrics, fake chrome, emoji icons, or stock imagery.
evidence.tokens: All OKLCH colors are confined to tokens.css and all rendered colors and font families are consumed through semantic variables.
evidence.contrast: Calculated WCAG ratios: light body 14.62, light muted 6.32, light focus 6.20, dark body 14.56, dark muted 8.59, dark focus 6.78.
evidence.responsive: Static audit confirms overflow-x: clip on html and body, minmax(0, 1fr) image-bearing grids, long-word wrapping, nowrap clickable labels, narrow-screen nav reduction, block-form tables, and reduced-motion handling.
evidence.accessibility: All custom SVG figures have title and description; every page has a skip link, landmarks, unique data-site-home navigation, visible focus styling, and dark-mode controls.
evidence.browserInspection: Not performed because local browser access to 127.0.0.1 was denied by the browser permission policy; no bypass was attempted.
